# Unserialize

> A stateless PHP serialized-data to JSON converter. Serialized objects are rejected and input is limited to 262,144 bytes.

## Documentation

- https://unserialize.dev/: Browser converter, PHP serialization format, WordPress workflow, and security guidance
- https://unserialize.dev/privacy: Privacy and retention contract
- https://unserialize.dev/developers: HTTP API and MCP integration guide
- https://unserialize.dev/openapi.json: OpenAPI 3.1 description

## Source

- https://github.com/roelmagdaleno/unserialize
